ExtraBar 1.2.9 – Link Up & Browse Smart! 🔗🧠

✨ What's New

  • Link Groups: Save a set of URLs and launch them all with one click – right from the bookmark widget or the bookmark manager! Syncs across devices and works offline!
  • Chrome Profile Routing (Beta): Route Shiori bookmarks into specific Google Chrome profiles based on their tags! Configure it under Shiori → Browser Routing!
  • Focused App Destination: When a bookmark has no matching profile rule, it opens in whatever app you were just using instead of forcing Chrome – seamless browsing!

⚡ Improvements

  • Expanded Free Plan: Free plan now includes 500 bookmarks and 2 Link Groups (up from 100 bookmarks) – more power for everyone!
  • Quick Actions Redesign: Bookmark widget edit/copy/delete buttons now sit side-by-side with a larger hit area and a friendlier edit icon – faster interactions!
  • Shiori Settings Refresh: Paid users get a new "Open Dashboard" shortcut and the action buttons have been restyled for a cleaner look!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Notch Mode + Shiori: Fixed notch mode closing when you interact with the Shiori bookmark popover – it now stays open through the whole interaction!
  • Notch Icon Clipping: Fixed icons getting clipped in notch mode with an odd number of apps – both sides now balance around the notch!
  • Notch Space Tracking: Fixed the notch overlay getting stuck on the previous Space – the bar now follows you when you switch Spaces or enter fullscreen!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraBar more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make – keep it coming! 💙
